question: Does 192-bit working precision give the same answer as 768-bit?
agreement: identical to 19 significant digits; they first differ at the 20th
iteration_count: identical (48) -- precision does not change the convergence path, only the cost per iteration
basis_for_192: Schur condition number measured at 6.0e34 ~ 2^116; 192 bits ~ 57 decimal digits leaves ~22 digits of margin
still_open: the condition number has NOT been measured in the UV sector (Gram + FESR + form-factor asymptotics together); if it is materially higher there, 192 bits would need re-checking.  See HANDOFF section 3.1(c).
